notes.title: Update for 2/16/2025
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes (v.1.2.6):[/b]
[list]
[*] Save/Load Bug Fixes
[*] Confirmation Button on Pause Menu
[*] Scene Transitions added
[*] Frozen movement when loading in saved game fixed
[*] New controls image added
[*] New controls (climb ledge 'p', enter doubles as 'e', sprint moved to 'shift',)
[*][u]Platformer Section Overhaul[/u]
[*] Jump sound added
[*] Grab removed and replaced with Climb Ledge
[*] New Animation for Climb Ledge + Sounds for miss and hit 
[*] New teleport system for climbing minarets with new sound and fade transition
[*] Coyote time added for the jump mechanic 
[*] Redesigned platformer dream sequence for ease of play and directionality
[*] New designed minaret assets
[*] Collision jittering addressed
[*] Base speed slightly increased in platformer sequence
[/list]

[/list]
